out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: ground beef and carnitas from 5/12
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI discarded

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooling whole potatoes.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI discussed and demonstrated proper cooling methods, ice bath rinse, chop and place in refrigerator or freezer

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee wash hands without soap and paper towels
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. CDI used soap and paper towels

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. Observed employee wash hands at ware washing sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI used hand sink

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed meat/vegetable dish in hot wells at 115-135f. Cooked chicken on shelf at 120f cooked 30 min ago.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI item mixed and reheated to 180f. Keep chicken hot or cool within time constraints. Placed in cooler and cooled to 71f in 30min

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: all 3 coolers on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: mini chef on counter at 50f. Ice encrusted around freezer spot and could need to defrost.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI tcs food removed and only used for non tcs food items. Residential refrigerators are not designed to withstand heavy traffic. Replace with commercial refrigerator if broken.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the Quat chemical sanitizing solution.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA, test kit.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution. No test kit available.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. CDI EHS tested solution. Observed in range. Ba-Sak (Inspection Date: 10/23/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Women’s Toilet room door is not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Employees Informed of Responsibility to Report
violations.observation: Employees are not aware of the reporting procedures concerning information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food. OBSERVED TWO NEW FOOD WORKERS WITHOUT SIGNED EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICIES.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall inform all food employees and conditional employees of their responsibility to report any information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissable through food as specified under 2-201.11(A). CDI: NEW FOOD EMPLOYEES SIGNED HEALTH POLICIES DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED FOOD WORKER TOUCHING RAW BEEF AND CHANGE GLOVES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI: EHS CORRECTED FOOD WORKER AND INSTRUCTED THEM TO WASH HANDS PRIOR TO PUTTING ON GLOVES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink being used TO STORE A METAL BOWL.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: REMOVED BOWL FROM HANDWASHING SINK. YOU MUST ONLY USE HANDWASHING SINKS FOR HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN FEMALE EMPLOYEE/PUBLIC BATHROOM TO NOT HAVE SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. INSTALL A SIGN INDICATING TO EMPLOYEES THAT THEY MUST WASH THEIR HANDS BEFORE RETURNING TO WORK IN THIS BATHROOM.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: OBSERVED ROTTEN APPLE IN COOLER NEXT TO WAREWASHING. OBSERVED TWO METAL SOUP CONTAINERS WITH MOLD COVERING THE INSIDE. OBSERVED REPURPOSED SOUR CREAM CONTAINER WITH MOLDY SUBSTANCE INSIDE.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. CDI: ALL UNSAFE FOOD WAS DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN IN STAND UP COOLER BY WAREWASHING AREA ON TOP OF RTE SAUCE. OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN IN WIC STORED OVER PREPARED FOODS. OBSERVED RAW BACON STORED ON TOP OF RTE SAUCES IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: ALL RAW ANIMAL FOODS REORGANIZED DURING INSPECTION BY COOKING TEMPERATURE. Ba-Sak (Inspection Date: 04/29/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Chemical sanitizer immersion time was not adequate for CHLORINE sanitizing solution. OBSERVED DISHWASHER NOT USING SANITIZER WHEN CLEANING DISHES.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. CDI: DISHWASHER WAS INSTRUCTED BY EHS AND USED PROPER CHLORINE SANITIZING SOLUTION FOR REQUIRED IMMERSION TIME AFTER RINSING DISHES.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SPAGHETTI NOODLES IN A DOUBLE STACKED PAN AT HOT HOLDING TABLE AT 107F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: DISCARDED. TCS ITEMS BEING HOT HELD MUST BE KEPT AT A TEMPERATURE OF 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN THE SAUCE COOLER ON COUNTER: HALF AND HALF AT 49F. OBSERVED IN GRAB AND GO COOLER: BLACKBERRY YOGURT AT 49F AND MILK AT 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS ITEMS OUT OF TEMPERATURE CONTROL WERE DISPOSED OF. YOU MUST MONITOR TEMPERATURES OF COOLERS CONTAINING TCS ITEMS TO ENSURE PROPER COLD HOLDING.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED ONLY TWO TCS ITEMS DATE MARKED IN FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: EHS EXPLAINED ALL TCS ITEMS KEPT FOR LONGER THAN 24HRS MUST BE DATE MARKED. A DATE MARKING SYSTEM MUST BE USED SO OUT OF DATE ITEMS CAN BE DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED BLEACH, BUTANE LIGHTER, WD-40, AND MIRACLE GRO NEXT TO FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI: ALL TOXIC ITEMS WERE RELOCATED TO A PROPER AND SEPARATE LOCATION.

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the CHLORINE solution was measured ABOVE 200 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. OBSERVED CHLORINE SANITIZER IN BUCKETS WITH A CONCENTRATION MEASURING ABOVE 200PPM.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of CHLORINE solution at 50-100ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI: SANITIZER SOLUTION WAS WATERED DOWN AND MEASURED TO BE AT THE CORRECT CONCENTRATION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN SITTING UNDER THE COUNTER. OBSERVED BEAN SALAD AND CORN SALAD AT PREP UNIT STACKED ON TOP OF EGGS WITH UNIT LID OPEN.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: CHICKEN WAS PLACED IN WIC AND BEAN AND CORN SALADS WERE PLACED DIRECTLY IN UNIT WITHOUT BEING STACKED. Ba-Sak (Inspection Date: 04/29/2025) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED SPICES, POWDERS, AND SAUCES WITHOUT LABELS
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: LABELED.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED TWO RICE SCOOPS STORED IN 73F-77F WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: SANITIZED AND STORED DRY. CEASE STORING IN LUKEWARM WATER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: SAUCE COOLER ON COUNTER AND GRAB AND GO COOLER OBSERVED THE SAUCE COOLER TO BE 47F AND HOLDING FOOD AT 49F OBSERVED THE GRAB AND GO COOLER TO BE 42F AND HOLDING FOOD PLACED AT THE WARMEST PART AT 49-50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: TCS ITEMS WERE DISPOSED OF AND UNITS WILL NOT BE USED FOR TCS COLD HOLDING.

violations.title: Food Not from Private Home
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is prepared in a private home, an unapproved food source, is distributed or offered for sale to the public: kimchi
violations.corrective_action: Food prepared in a private home may NOT be used or offered for human consumption in a food establishment. CDI. Kimchi taken home.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Chemical sanitizer immersion time was not adequate for chlorine sanitizing solution. Observed washer not using any sanitizer at all while washing dishes.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. CDI all dishes were sanitized in bleach for 10seconds.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed cutting boards located at the prep line that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI. Cleaned/sanitized

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: chicken salad made 2 days ago.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: deli meats and cheese
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. Ba-Sak (Inspection Date: 11/13/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): fried chicken on counter without time control written. Observed employee stick chicken in the freezer 30min after start of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. CDI. Time control written. Food will be discarded after 4 hours and not saved in the freezer.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level of the sanitizer basin is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. Cut the pipe of the sanitizer basin to create an air gap that leads to the floor drain.
